about: One Claude turn with a permission ask, as the state engine reports it per poll (bridge/state-engine.ts: a transition fires only when a pane's status differs from its last poll; the first sighting fires none). No recorded status log exists in the repo, so this is built from the code and the tests: Herdr's agent_status set (HERDR_API.md), `working -> blocked` for a permission dialog (and the engine's liftScreenAsks), `blocked -> working` once answered, `working -> done` at the turn end on Herdr <= 0.8, and `done -> idle` after the person looks (state-engine.test.ts 'done -> idle must not bump'). `idleOnly` is the same turn on Herdr 0.9, tmux or zellij, which report the end as idle (notifications.ts, issue #345).
